## Checkpoint: infrastructure 100% ready, one blocker remains

Built and verified live:
- **`/opt/veridian/chatgpt-audit/`** — real sandboxed directory, 23 domain subfolders
- **`scripts/chatgpt_audit_guard.py`** — mechanical write-scope guard (not policy prose). Live-tested: rejects `/opt/veridian/repos/compliance-tracker/src/lib/foo.ts` (exit 1), allows `/opt/veridian/chatgpt-audit/Architecture/test.yaml` (exit 0), also rejects a lookalike-prefix path, and a real guarded write is refused (nothing written) outside scope
- **`scripts/chatgpt_audit_versioning.py`** — lock-protected incrementing `audit_id` + timestamped filenames, never overwrites
- **`ai-os/CHATGPT_AUDIT_RECORD_SCHEMA_2026-07-24.yaml`** — full record schema + 9 linkage fields
- **`scripts/generate_chatgpt_audit_index.py`** → **`ai-os/CHATGPT_AUDIT_MASTER_CATALOGUE_2026-07-24.yaml`** + live local index, machine-generated, 0 records (correct, by design)
- **`ai-os/CHATGPT_AUDIT_BLOCKER_2026-07-24.yaml`** — exact call shape for when the key exists, filed as `awaiting_owner_decision` in `OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED_2026-07-23.yaml`
- `registries.chatgpt_audit_workspace` in `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` + all 6 artifacts registered in `knowledge_engine` (`VERIFIED_MATCH`)

Committed in two units, pushed, PR opened: **https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/46**

**What's needed to go live**: a real `OPENAI_API_KEY` (none exists — confirmed only a placeholder comment in `/opt/veridian/shared/.env`) and the Owner naming the exact model, per `CHATGPT_AUDIT_BLOCKER_2026-07-24.yaml`. No substitute provider was used — that would have been a silent model swap the Owner didn't ask for. Once both are supplied, a future task wires the real ChatGPT call through the guard/versioning scripts already built here.
